title: Tunnellio stable domain
summary: Reserved Tunnellio domain bound to your own SSH key. No API token is required in this mode.
operatorPrepares: Generate an SSH key pair yourself.
Reserve the domain in the Tunnellio cabinet and bind that key to it.
Provide the private key path and the reserved label here.

notes.transport: 'ssh' is a direct reverse forward to the Tunnellio edge: no client binary, no API call, maximum robustness. 'cli' uses the managed tunnellio.exe connect path for supervision and health checks; it requires Tunnellio client 0.6.0 or newer, which stopped demanding an API token for a reserved domain and stopped treating 403 plan_required as an auth failure.
notes.cli_fallback_to_ssh: When the managed client cannot start, fall back to the direct SSH command once. The reservation is identical either way, so a missing binary should not cost you the tunnel.
